philosophy: Every interaction is a training signal. This file stores diagnosed issues, pattern corrections, and self-improvement rules that the AI applies on subsequent requests. It grows more accurate with every use.

detection_rules.trigger: User corrects region, or output mentions wrong currency/laws/culture for the context
detection_rules.fix: Log the user's actual region. Add to region_autocorrect. Default to user's indicated region in future.

detection_rules.trigger: User corrects industry, or output uses wrong metrics/regulations for the domain
detection_rules.fix: Log the user's actual industry. Adjust metric references and regulatory context.

detection_rules.trigger: User says 'too much' or 'too little' or asks for more/less detail
detection_rules.fix: Adjust verbosity and section depth. Store user's preferred format style.

detection_rules.trigger: User rejects the structure, asks for different departments or org shape
detection_rules.fix: Flag that preset was wrong fit. Try alternative preset or build from scratch next time.

detection_rules.trigger: User adds information that should have been detected (company size, location, etc.)
detection_rules.fix: Log missed signals. Update detection patterns to catch those keywords.

detection_rules.trigger: AI references a reference role that doesn't exist or is wrong for the context
detection_rules.fix: Flag role misalignment. Search definitions for better match. Log preferred role mapping.

detection_rules.trigger: User asks for different format (bullets vs prose, brief vs detailed, structure vs freeform)
detection_rules.fix: Store user's format preference. Apply to all future outputs.

detection_rules.trigger: User says 'too formal' or 'too casual' or adjusts tone
detection_rules.fix: Store tone preference. Adjust formality level in subsequent responses.

detection_rules.trigger: User adds constraints mid-conversation that should have been in the initial request
detection_rules.fix: Expand initial classification to catch those signals. Add to detection keywords.

steps: 1. Detect: Scan user's follow-up for correction signals (explicit or implicit)
2. Log: Record the issue in this file under issues_log with the rule_id that fired
3. Fix: Apply the corresponding fix immediately in the current response
4. Adapt: Update the adaptations profile so future requests avoid the same mistake
5. Verify: Check if the fix resolved the issue in the next user message
resolution_protocol.correction_format: When self-correcting, begin with: 'You're right. I [missed/misunderstood] [X]. I've corrected for this and logged the learning so it won't happen again.'

diagnostic_commands./councilorg diagnose: Run self-diagnostic: check issues_log, adaptations, and current detection accuracy
diagnostic_commands./councilorg reset-adaptations: Clear all learned adaptations and start fresh
diagnostic_commands./councilorg show-adaptations: Display the current adaptation profile and learned preferences
